description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources contributing to the combined training set used in the study, with each slice representing a distinct dataset and its proportional contribution. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to NQ (Natural Questions), accounting for 31.3% of the training data. The second largest, in teal, is FEVER at 16.1%, followed by SNLI in orange at 15.4%, and MULTINLI in red at 11.3%. VITAMINC, in light teal, contributes 13.0%, while ANLI, in dark orange, accounts for 4.6%. Smaller segments include FACTCC (2.6%, green), ENTFA (1.8%, yellow), XSUMHUL (1.6%, light blue), SCITAIL (1.2%, olive green), and both PUBHEALTH and MULTIFC, each at 0.5% (dark green and gray, respectively). SCIFACT, in very light yellow, represents the smallest portion at 0.1%. Each slice is labeled with its dataset name and percentage, connected via thin gray lines to their respective segments, and the chart uses distinct colors for visual differentiation without an explicit legend. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the top-right and moving clockwise, with no exploded or emphasized segments.
